mostWorthwhile.text: Powering protein construction was most worthwhile: it connected food, ATP and DNA instructions to making proteins with different shapes.

leastWorthwhile.text: Supplying glucose was a fairly predictable setup step; it mainly showed that oxygen still needed to enter separately.

surprise.text: The pump moved particles toward the more crowded side using ATP. That gave me a clearer idea of what the pump does.

arbitrary.text: None felt especially arbitrary. The pictures and goals pointed to each pairing, although they did not explain in detail how ATP changes the pump's shape.

continue.text: I would choose to try another chapter: connecting ATP to both protein building and the membrane pump made me curious about how the next cell parts fit together.
